If Will Warren records 5+ strikeouts in the New York Y vs Minnesota professional baseball game originally scheduled for Sep 14, 2026 at 7:40 PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Will Warren is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Will Warren is not a starting pitcher but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, relief appearances will not count towards this market.
If Will Warren is a starting pitcher and records at least one batter faced the market will settle based on strikeouts recorded.
